description: This file defines the S3UriParser class, which provides methods to parse various Amazon S3 URIs to extract components such as bucket name, key, region, and style (path vs virtual hosted). It handles parsing of different URI formats, including StreamWrapper, custom endpoints, and ARN-based URIs.

classes.name: S3UriParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing S3 URIs into components such as bucket, key, region, and style.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that accepts a URI or URI-like string and returns an associative array with parsed S3 components, handling ARN, StreamWrapper, and other URI formats.

methods.name: parseS3UrlComponents
methods.description: Extracts scheme, host, and path components from a given URI string.

methods.name: parseStreamWrapper
methods.description: Parses URIs with the s3:// scheme to extract bucket and key.

methods.name: parseCustomEndpoint
methods.description: Parses custom endpoint URIs to extract bucket and key.

methods.name: parsePathStyle
methods.description: Parses path-style S3 URLs to extract bucket and key.

methods.name: parseVirtualHosted
methods.description: Parses virtual hosted style S3 URLs to extract bucket and key.
